parameters.query:
WITH requested AS (SELECT $1::text AS external_key)
SELECT
  requested.external_key AS requested_key,
  item.external_key,
  item.status::text AS status,
  item.derived_formats,
  item.generated_content,
  item.approved_at,
  item.approved_by
FROM requested
LEFT JOIN marketing.content_items AS item
  ON item.external_key = requested.external_key
 AND item.status IN ('approved', 'rendered')
 AND item.approved_at IS NOT NULL
 AND item.approved_by IS NOT NULL
 AND item.derived_formats ? 'short_video'
LIMIT 1;
